description: Create a fresh deployment wallet and fund it from the treasury wallet. Uses the SVM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY or EVM_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable as the funding source. The new wallet is set as the active wallet for signing. Use this before printr_launch_token to deploy tokens without exposing the treasury. Requires PRINTR_DEPLOYMENT_PASSWORD to be set for wallet encryption.

amount.description: Amount to fund in human-readable units (e.g. '0.6' for 0.6 SOL)

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (e.g. 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana mainnet)

name: printr_fund_deployment_wallet

amount_funded.description: Amount transferred to the new wallet

wallet_id.description: Keystore wallet ID for the persisted wallet
